items.title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
items.summary_raw: Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication. Timely news may reach an investor before prices fully adjust, whereas older news may already be reflected in prices. We examine two ways to handle aging signals: retain them and give a portfolio policy timing information, or filter them out before portfolio selection. A fixed large language model (LLM) extracts signals from public SEC disclosures. We compare these treatments in reinforcement learning (RL) policies and LLMs that choose portfolios directly. We evaluate returns after trading costs in historical tests over 2
items.summary_cn: 论文研究财经新闻信号随时间衰减后应如何进入组合决策：是保留旧信号并显式提供时间信息，还是在组合选择前过滤掉。作者用固定 LLM 从 SEC 公开披露中提取信号，并比较强化学习策略与直接选组合的 LLM，在计入交易费用的历史测试中评估效果。
items.why_cn: 它直接触及量化交易中最常见却最容易被忽略的信号时效性，并给出了 LLM 信号与 RL 组合管理的可复现结合方式。

items.title: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
items.summary_raw: LLM agents that act on live Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, remember what they have done and improve from outcomes without weakening their own safeguards. We study this problem in autonomous investing, where every action is irreversible and based on untrusted Web content. We present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that draws the boundary of self-evolution in its type system. First, nine role-specialised agents decide jointly: four analysts read news feeds, SEC filings, macroeconomic series and market data and emit typed reports, from which a Portfolio Manager sets target positi
items.summary_cn: Steward 是一个面向自主投资的九角色多智能体 LLM 系统，由分析新闻、SEC 文件、宏观序列和市场数据的代理输出带类型报告，再由组合经理生成目标仓位。其核心设计是在类型系统中划定自我进化边界，让系统能从结果中学习，同时不削弱安全约束。
items.why_cn: 它为会真实下单的 AI 投资代理提供了兼顾自我改进、审计和风控边界的工程蓝图。

items.title: Lineage-Aware Search Control for LLM-Based Evolutionary Factor Mining
items.summary_raw: Formulaic alpha factor mining searches for symbolic expressions that transform market data into predictive signals. Recent LLM-based evolutionary factor mining methods use large language models as semantic variation operators. Under the conventional LLM-EA paradigm, stochastic variation and fitness-based selection can leave the search weakly directed and concentrated around a narrow set of structurally similar factors. We argue that these limitations arise because current methods mainly organize search at the individual and population levels, leaving lineage-level control underused. A lineage
items.summary_cn: 论文指出传统 LLM 进化式因子挖掘过度依赖个体和种群层面的随机变异，容易使搜索方向薄弱并聚集在结构相似的因子上。作者提出在“谱系”层面进行搜索控制，以更系统地组织 LLM 作为语义变异算子的探索过程。
items.why_cn: 它有望提升自动化 Alpha 因子挖掘的多样性、方向性和可解释性，减少无效因子冗余。

items.title: Distributions or Quantiles? A Convex Variational Theory of Worst-Case Risk
items.summary_raw: Worst-case risk evaluation is central to finance and operations research, yet existing analytical results remain fragmented and largely confined to ambiguity sets with specific structures. Using spectral risk measures as the underlying class, we develop a convex variational theory that unifies these analyses and extends them to richer ambiguity models. The theory rests on a representation principle: use the quantile or distribution formulation that preserves convexity of the full ambiguity set. In both representations, the resulting optimality conditions provide a systematic route to identify
items.summary_cn: 文章以谱风险度量为基础，建立统一的最坏情形风险凸变分理论，并解释何时应使用分布或分位数表示以保持完整模糊集的凸性。该框架把原先分散在不同模糊集结构中的结果推广到更丰富的稳健风险模型，并给出识别最坏情形的系统条件。
items.why_cn: 这为压力测试、尾部风险预算和分布不确定性下的组合风险控制提供了更统一的数学工具。

items.title: [TauricResearch/TradingAgents] PR: fix(portfolio): match held tickers under broker aliases
items.summary_raw: Fixes #1556. ## What `PortfolioContext.position_in()` compared raw spellings, so a position held under a broker symbol (`BTCUSDT`) was reported as absent when the analyzer ran on the canonical symbol (`BTC-USD`), and the units landed under `Other positions`. That block reaches the Trader, risk manag
items.summary_cn: 该 TradingAgents 修复解决券商交易代码与规范代码不一致的问题，例如持仓使用 BTCUSDT 而分析器使用 BTC-USD 时会被误判为无持仓。修复后，别名持仓能被正确识别，避免单位落入“其他持仓”并继续向交易和风控模块传递错误上下文。
items.why_cn: 这类看似细小的符号归一化错误会直接污染仓位、风险和交易决策，是实盘 AI 代理必须消除的基础缺陷。

items.title: [microsoft/RD-Agent] PR: fix: return each analyzed error once in analyze_error
items.summary_raw: ## Description `CoSTEERRAGStrategyV2.analyze_error` returned the same error twice when the knowledge graph held a matching error node and at least one other error node: once as the existing `UndirectedNode`, once as a plain string. It now returns each analyzed error once. ## Motivation and Context F
items.summary_cn: 微软 RD-Agent 的该 PR 修复了 CoSTEERRAGStrategyV2.analyze_error 在知识图谱同时包含匹配节点和其他错误节点时重复返回同一错误的问题。修改后，每个已分析错误只返回一次，避免节点对象与字符串混合造成重复诊断。
items.why_cn: 更可靠的错误归因会提升自动化研发与量化实验代理的调试效率，减少重复修复和错误上下文累积。

items.title: Directionally Correct Views in Portfolio Optimization
items.summary_raw: Portfolio optimization techniques often use historical data to estimate parameters for Markowitz-type or ML models. Effective allocation requires a way to align the available data with conditions expected over the investment horizon. Inspired by the Black-Litterman framework, we ask whether incorporating expert views leads to better portfolio allocations. In a simple Markowitz setting, we show that even a small amount of directionally correct information can materially improve investment decisions. We also discuss how expert views can be incorporated in end-to-end portfolio models using entrop
items.summary_cn: 论文借鉴 Black-Litterman 框架，研究在 Markowitz 型组合优化中加入专家方向性观点是否能改善配置。结果显示，即使少量方向正确的信息也能显著改善投资决策，作者还讨论了如何用熵相关方法把专家观点纳入端到端组合模型。
items.why_cn: 它为人工判断、LLM 观点或宏观信号如何规范地进入组合优化提供了清晰依据。

items.title: Equilibria and Learning in Competitive Market Making
items.summary_raw: We propose a market-making game played among $N \ge 2$ strategic market makers and a single non-strategic representative trader. In a continuous quote space, standard finite-game arguments do not apply, while non-convex and discontinuous payoffs rule out classical continuous existence results and complicate learning. Nonetheless, we characterize pure-strategy Nash equilibria (PSNEs) and show that at least one PSNE always exists under minimal assumptions on the underlying asset value distribution, and that the equilibrium bid-ask spread widens strictly with asset value volatility. To obtain a t
items.summary_cn: 论文构建一个由多个策略性做市商和单一非策略代表交易者组成的连续报价做市博弈，并处理非凸、非连续收益带来的均衡与学习困难。作者证明在资产价值分布的最小假设下纯策略纳什均衡总存在，且均衡买卖价差会随资产价值波动率严格扩大。
items.why_cn: 它把做市竞争、价差形成和波动率联系起来，对高频做市策略与多代理市场仿真都有直接参考价值。

items.title: Multiple Stopping and Exercise Boundaries for American Put Options
items.summary_raw: This article studies a finite-horizon American put option with up to $m$ exercise rights under the risk-neutral Black--Scholes model, where consecutive exercises must be separated by a prescribed refractory period $δ>0$ and unused rights may expire. For each number of remaining rights, we show that optimal exercise is characterized by a single exercise boundary and that these boundaries are ordered by the number of remaining rights. We prove optimality of the first boundary-hitting time and establish local Lipschitz continuity of the exercise boundaries within each open deadline strip. Away fr
items.summary_cn: 文章研究有限期限内最多可行权 m 次、相邻行权之间必须有冷却期的美式看跌期权。作者证明在每种剩余行权次数下最优策略由单一行权边界刻画，这些边界随剩余权利数量有序排列，并满足局部 Lipschitz 连续性。
items.why_cn: 它为多次行权、路径受限期权和对冲工具的定价与执行算法提供了可落地的边界结构。

items.title: What Prediction-Market Contracts Reveal at Launch: Trading Volume and Dispute Risk
items.summary_raw: Using a near-census of 802,863 resolved markets listed on Polymarket between January 2023 and May 2026, and only information available at listing (the market's title and description, named resolution source, and contract metadata), we predict lifetime trading volume and whether settlement is later disputed. Contract information predicts trading volume well (out-of-sample $R^2 = 0.747$ for log volume), and most of the signal is interpretable: market topic provides the largest gain ($+0.289$ $R^2$ over a $0.220$ contract-feature baseline), wording and resolution-rule design add smaller but measu
items.summary_cn: 作者使用 2023 年 1 月至 2026 年 5 月 Polymarket 上 802,863 个已结算市场的近全量数据，仅用上线时的标题、描述、结算来源和合约元数据预测生命周期成交量与结算争议。模型对成交量预测表现很强，样本外对数成交量 R² 达 0.747，且主题、措辞和结算规则设计都提供可解释信号。
items.why_cn: 它说明合约文本本身就能预测流动性和争议风险，对预测市场做市、事件交易和新合约筛选很有价值。

items.title: A game-theoretic analysis of the market microstructure in decentralized exchanges with concentrated liquidity
items.summary_raw: We study strategic liquidity provision in decentralized exchanges with concentrated liquidity as a mean-field game. Liquidity providers choose the width of their price range and when to rebalance it, pay a transaction cost at each rebalancing, and share the fees collected at each tick in proportion to their liquidity, so that each provider's income depends on the state of the population. We formulate the problem as a controlled continuous-time Markov chain on a finite state space. In an averaged version of the game, in which a rebalanced position is re-centered at a draw from the long-run law
items.summary_cn: 论文把集中流动性去中心化交易所中的策略性流动性供给建模为平均场博弈，流动性提供者需要选择价格区间宽度和再平衡时机。模型以受控连续时间马尔可夫链刻画个体区间、交易成本、手续费分配和群体状态之间的相互作用。
items.why_cn: 它为 Uniswap V3 类做市中的区间选择、调仓频率和费用收益权衡提供了博弈论基础。

items.title: Learning to Incentivise: Using Reinforcement Learning for Sustainable Urban Mobility
items.summary_raw: Traffic management has traditionally focused on toll-based and road pricing solutions. However, road pricing often raises concerns about accessibility and public dissatisfaction, leading to its prohibition in some places, such as Finland. This study optimises the dynamic allocation of incentives to drivers, encouraging them to reroute onto alternative (potentially longer) paths to achieve greater societal benefit, reduced total travel time (TTT) and total emissions in the transportation network, contributing to sustainable urban mobility. We employ a multi-agent reinforcement learning approach
items.summary_cn: 论文把城市出行激励分配视为动态优化问题，用多智能体强化学习鼓励司机改道到更优替代路径。目标是在不依赖传统道路收费的情况下降低全网总出行时间和排放，从而支持可持续城市交通。
items.why_cn: 虽然场景不在金融市场，其多智能体激励设计与强化学习机制可迁移到做市激励、交易路由和资源分配问题。

items.title: Intraday Forecasting Ability and Liquidity Provision of Institutional Traders
items.summary_raw: This study uses a high-frequency dataset from a stock exchange to examine how forecasting ability and liquidity provision relate to institutional traders' proprietary intraday profitability. We discover persistent forecasting abilities among traders. Specifically, we demonstrate that hypothetical flow-following strategies based on the execution flows of these skillful traders yield annualized Sharpe ratios ranging from 16 to 63 across various trading frequencies. We match buy and sell executions into positions, linking realized profit and loss (P&L) to horizon-matched forecasting proxies and t
items.summary_cn: 研究利用交易所高频数据分析机构交易者的日内预测能力、流动性供给与自营盈利之间的关系。作者发现部分交易者具有持续预测能力，基于这些熟练交易者执行流构建的假设跟随策略在不同频率下展现出极高年化 Sharpe，并把已实现盈亏与对应期限的预测代理变量相连接。
items.why_cn: 它为识别聪明订单流、构造日内跟随信号以及评估流动性供给价值提供了实证依据。

items.title: Multichoice Modeling: Exploring Decision Configuration Space under Uncertainty
items.summary_raw: Decision support has become sophisticated at exploring uncertainty, but much less so at representing the architecture of the decision itself. As a result, the decision space is often narrowed before uncertainty is analyzed, leaving interactions among choices and the effects of alternatives they imply largely invisible. This paper introduces multichoice modeling, a framework for making large decision configuration spaces explicit and computationally explorable under uncertainty. Drawing on the logic of rugged landscapes, we conceptualize such problems as contingent performance landscapes, where
items.summary_cn: 论文提出“多选择建模”，把复杂决策的配置空间显式展开，而不是在分析不确定性前过早收窄备选架构。借助崎岖适应度景观的思想，该框架将决策问题视作情境化绩效景观，使不同选择组合及其交互能够被计算化探索。
items.why_cn: 它可启发量化研究者把策略组件、组合约束和执行方案作为整体配置空间优化，而非孤立调参。

items.title: Dynamics of the Liquidity Profile in Concentrated Liquidity Provision: An SPIDE Approach
items.summary_raw: We model the dynamics of the liquidity profile in Uniswap~V3 and other concentrated-liquidity automated market makers with a stochastic partial integro-differential equation (SPIDE). The profile, the aggregate of all provider positions across tick space, evolves under a degenerate Sturm--Liouville operator, which encodes mean-reverting concentration around the market price, coupled with a Hilbert--Schmidt integral operator, which captures nonlocal redistribution driven by provider repositioning. We establish existence and uniqueness of the mild solution in a weighted $L^2$ space built on the G
items.summary_cn: 作者用随机偏积分微分方程刻画 Uniswap V3 等集中流动性 AMM 的流动性剖面动态。模型用退化 Sturm-Liouville 算子描述流动性围绕市场价格的均值回复集中，并用 Hilbert-Schmidt 积分算子捕捉提供者重新定位造成的非局部再分配，同时证明弱解的存在唯一性。
items.why_cn: 它为集中流动性池的流动性演化、冲击传播和 LP 风险建模提供了更严格的连续时间框架。

items.title: Less Wrong
items.summary_raw: A fundamental twist on momentum leading to a 1.15 Sharpe strategy
items.summary_cn: Quantitativo 的这篇文章提出对经典动量进行一个基础但有价值的改造，并报告了 Sharpe 比率约 1.15 的策略结果。标题同时提醒读者，策略研究中最危险的情形是误以为自己拥有盈利策略，而实际上它可能只是回测偏差或错误的产物。
items.why_cn: 它把可交易的动量改进与策略证伪意识结合起来，适合用来检查动量策略的稳健性和研究流程。

items.title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
items.summary_raw: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an i
items.summary_cn: 论文研究测试时推理扩展中的候选剪枝：模型先生成大量短前缀，再决定哪些候选值得继续消耗算力。作者提出直接优化 Pass@k 的思想剪枝方法，在候选最终质量与多样性之间取得更好的平衡。
items.why_cn: 它能降低 AI 交易代理在研究、代码生成和复杂决策中的推理成本，同时保留多路径探索能力。
